counterevidence: Lags estimated on a handful of quarters are dominated by single rounds.
definition: Cross-correlation lag, in quarters, between primary-round dollars into a sub-layer and its members' revenue (P1 seed indicator 13).

direction_rule.rationale: Needs at least eight quarters of both series before a lag can be estimated.

name: Venture flow to revenue lag
tracker_interpretation: Not yet measurable; fewer than eight quarters of paired series exist.
unpublished_reason: Not yet measurable: the estimate needs at least eight quarters of both venture dollars and revenue for the same sub-layer; the venture series starts in 2023 and revenue exists only for the frontier labs.
why_it_matters: Whether venture money leads or follows revenue tells you whether the flow is a forecast or a reaction.
